title: Vanilla V2
description: Vanilla, but sweeter! (a few enhancements and optimisations)
body:
“Vanilla V2” is a curated modpack for Minecraft: Java Edition designed to enhance and expand the core vanilla experience without straying from its original identity. The purpose of this project is to refine gameplay by introducing quality-of-life improvements, subtle visual upgrades, and balanced content additions that feel natural within the base game.

Rather than overhauling mechanics or drastically changing progression, Vanilla V2 focuses on preserving the familiar feel of Minecraft while making it smoother, more immersive, and more engaging. This includes improvements to performance, user interface, world generation, and minor gameplay systems, all carefully selected to maintain compatibility with vanilla-style play.

The function of the modpack is to provide players with a “better vanilla” experience—one that feels like an official evolution of the game, staying true to its simplicity and creativity while quietly enhancing depth and enjoyment.
